sentences.en: Let no one lightly discuss the subject of rites.
sentences.zh: 不要轻率地讨论礼仪的话题。

sentences.en: The Italian Jewish rite has elements of both Sephardi and Ashkenazi traditions.
sentences.zh: 意大利犹太教的仪式融合了塞法迪和阿什肯纳兹传统的元素。

sentences.en: This rite is part of their religion.
sentences.zh: 这种仪式是他们宗教的一部分。
